text:
Sofia (partnerships): morning all  final go/no-go thread for the joint marketplace listing. pockets: cloud marketplace packaging (AWS/Azure), HW partner badge, SI walkthrough. we need a clear decision rule by EOD.
Ibrahim (marketing): i'll own press + blog. drafting two headlines: partner-forward and neutral fallback. will post copy by 14:00 PT.
Nina (product): staging is at staging.redwood.com/marketplace-co. missing: partner-provided marketplace tile image (SVG), and an example deploy snippet for Azure Marketplace listing. if not in by 12:30 PT i'll add a generic sample.
Carlos (solutions): SI preview: live session preferred. need sandbox creds, sample dataset, and a short topology doc. if creds delayed >4h we do recorded walkthrough. I'll draft a 12-min runbook.
Priya (legal): legal constraint: partner quote must be an explicit signed approval (email ok). HW badge copy needs partner cert or we use "validated with" language. embargo needs UTC timestamp.
Sofia (partnerships): embargo proposed Wed 18:00 UTC. partners must return assets + signed approvals by Tue 22:00 UTC or we switch to fallback messaging.
Ibrahim (marketing): noted. i'll prepare a fallback hero that doesn't mention partner name and queue both variants in CMS for a quick flip.
Nina (product): mobile UX glitch: hero collapses if tile missing. i'll deploy a small CSS placeholder by 11:45 PT to stabilize layout.
Carlos (solutions): pinged SI partner at 1777702140. they replied "working on security sign-off, likely by EOD." asked them for a scoped token and endpoint.
shiproom-bot: created task RED-MP-9021: "Marketplace joint-listing go/no-go" assigned to Ibrahim/Nina/Carlos, due 2024-08-30 22:00 UTC. https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/RED-MP-9021
Sofia (partnerships): condensed checklist (copy into thread):
```
- Embargo: Wed 18:00 UTC
- Assets: marketplace tile SVG + azure deploy snippet -> Partner due Tue 22:00 UTC
- Signed quote + HW cert blurb -> Partner due Tue 22:00 UTC (Priya review)
- Hero copy variants -> Ibrahim -> 14:00 PT
- SI creds + sample data -> Partner -> Carlos -> aim EOD
- Staging placeholder for missing tile -> Nina -> deploy by 11:45 PT
- Ship ticket RED-MP-9021
```
Ibrahim (marketing): posting draft headline now: "Redwood & PartnerX bring managed inference to the marketplace" (partner-forward). fallback: "Run inference where your apps run  with Redwood".
Priya (legal): prefer fallback headline if partner hasn't signed the quote. for partner-forward: need signed approval and no unverified performance claims.
Nina (product): placeholder CSS deployed at 1777702240. staging stable.
Carlos (solutions): partner uploaded partial creds at 1777702280 (token only). requested endpoint + sample data.
Sofia (partnerships): decision rule reminder: if all assets + signed approvals in by Tue 22:00 UTC we proceed with co-announce under embargo Wed 18:00 UTC. otherwise flip to neutral landing + company-only blog and schedule partner spotlight after launch. i'll escalate any slips.
Ibrahim (marketing): i'll queue both CTA paths in CMS and leave a clear switch note.
Priya (legal): i'll standby to review the signed quote; please @Priya when partner posts it.
Carlos (solutions): will confirm sandbox readiness in-thread once endpoint received. if not by 18:00 PT I'll record demo run and upload link.
Sofia (partnerships): thanks team. reconvene at shiproom 1hr before embargo for final signoff. add any blockers here and i'll follow up with partner PM. :bell:
